scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh? Wwwaaaah--!
Y-you're--it's-it's--
It's a freakin' Bard!
D-don't come any closer!
I... I don't like you guys!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
诶？哇啊啊啊——！
你...你是...你是...
该死的诗人！
不...不要靠近我！
我...我不喜欢你们这种人！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh? Wwwaaaah--!
Y-you're--it's-it's--
It's a freakin' Minstrel!
D-don't come any closer!
I... I don't like you guys!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
诶？哇啊啊啊——！
你...你是...你是...
该死的宫廷乐师！
不...不要靠近我！
我...我不喜欢你们这种人！

scripts.text: Wha--? Why the heck not?
scripts.translation: 什...？为什么不行？

scripts.text: Hey, take it easy, man.
scripts.translation: 嘿，冷静点，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
N-no! Don't look at me!
I know what you're trying
to do! Please, I haven't
done anything to you!
J-just s-stay away!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
不...不要看我！
我知道你想干什么！求求你，我什么也没做啊！
请...请离我远点！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
I'm not really trying
to do anything. Why
don't you relax, and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...
我其实没想做什么。你放松一下，然后...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Relax?! Nobody believes me
when I tell them how dangerous
you guys are. You think you're
so smug with your funny jokes
and lovely songs, but I know
what kind of powers you have!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
放松？！没人相信我告诉你们有多危险。你们自以为很了不起，讲着笑话唱着歌，但我清楚你们拥有怎样的力量！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
N-no! Don't look at me!
I know what you're trying
to do! Please, I haven't
done anything to you!
J-just s-stay away!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
不...不要看我！
我知道你想干什么！求求你，我什么也没做啊！
请...请离我远点！

scripts.text: Offer him a drink.
scripts.translation: 请他喝一杯。

scripts.text: Reassure him that you're safe.
scripts.translation: 向他保证你是安全的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I don't know what
you've got against me, but
you really need to relax.
Here, have a drink on me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听着，我不知道你为什么对我有偏见，但你真的需要放松一下。来，我请客喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh~! Isn't that
a Tropical Sograt?
That's my favorite
drink in all the world!
Thanks so--waitaminute.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
哦~！这不是热带的苏克拉特吗？
这可是我全世界最喜欢的饮料！
谢...谢...等等。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh~! Isn't that
a Tropical Sograt?
That's my favorite
drink in all the world!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
哦~！这不是热带的苏克拉特吗？
这可是我全世界最喜欢的饮料！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
This is some sort
of weird trick, isn't it?
And to think I almost
f-f-fell for it! P-please
j-just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
这肯定是某种诡计，对吧？
没想到我差点就...就上当了！请...请别缠着我！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Wait, I've seen you before.
And you brought me a drink
just like this one. You...
You d-didn't learn th-that
w-w-weird skill, d-did you?
Wait, no. You couldn't have...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
等等，我以前见过你。
你也给我带过一样的饮料。你...
你...你不会学了那种...那种奇怪的技能吧？
不对，不可能...你不可能...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, please~
You know, I think
that maybe you
worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀~
你知道吗，我觉得
你可能是想太多了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
^333333*Gulp Gulp*^000000
Ahhhh~ Oh, you don't
understand how long I've
been wanting this drink!
It tastes so good, and
now I feel sooo relaxed...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
^333333*咕咚咕咚*^000000
啊~！你不知道我有多想喝这个！
味道真好，我现在感觉好...好放松...

scripts.text: See? I'm not dangerous at all~
scripts.translation: 看吧？我一点都不危险~

scripts.text: So what makes someone like me so scary?
scripts.translation: 那像我这样的人为什么这么可怕呢？

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Hmmm... Maybe.
Maybe all of you Bards
and Minstrels aren't that
bad. But I can never forget
what that Bard did to me...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
嗯...也许吧。
也许你们所有诗人和宫廷乐师
都没那么坏。但我永远忘不了
那个诗人对我做的事...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
It all started when I was
traveling through Umbala and
met a strange Bard who was
studying under the tutelage
of Puchuchartan, the Utan
Shaman of the village.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
一切都要从我在汶巴拉旅行时说起，
我遇到了一个奇怪的诗人，
他正在村里乌坦萨满普楚查尔坦的指导下学习。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
That Bard and I got along fairly well until he took me to Umbala's
Bungee Jump. He insisted that I jump at least once for the ''full
Umbala experience.'' I refused, seeing as they don't use bungees.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
我和那个诗人相处得还算融洽，直到他带我去汶巴拉的蹦极。他坚持让我至少跳一次，说是为了“完整的汶巴拉体验”。我拒绝了，毕竟那里用的不是真正的蹦极绳。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
The Bard seemed offended
and claimed it was perfectly
safe, and that only a few people
have died by jumping. Then, he
just... He gave me this intense look.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
诗人似乎很生气，声称这非常安全，只有少数人因为跳下去而死亡。然后，他只是...他给了我一个非常强烈的眼神。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
His eyes seemed so full
of rage! I remember him
mumbling something, and
all of a sudden, I lost control
of my body! My arms and legs
were just moving on their own!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
他的眼睛里充满了怒火！我记得他嘟囔着什么，突然之间，我失去了对身体的控制！我的四肢开始不由自主地动起来！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Before long, I found myself
struggling to keep myself from
leaping off that Bungee Jump.
But the more I resisted, the
more violently I'd flail toward
the edge. It was horrible!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
没过多久，我发现自己拼命想要阻止自己跳下那个蹦极台。但我越是抵抗，身体就越猛烈地朝边缘挣扎。太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
That was the most terrifying
experience of my life! It was
bad enough that I risked my
life, but that feeling of not
having any control over your
body is so overwhelming!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
那是我一生中最恐怖的经历！虽然冒着生命危险已经够糟糕了，但那种无法控制自己身体的感觉真是令人窒息！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, you're saying
a Bard did this to you?
I've never heard of a song
or skill with that sort of effect before. That's really strange...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你是说一个诗人对你做了这种事？
我从未听说过有歌曲或技能能产生这种效果。这真的很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Well, I've never heard
of that sort of power up
until I had to experience
it for myself. Oh, I can still
see that evil smile of his
in my nightmares...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
嗯，在我亲身体验之前，我也从未听说过这种力量。哦，我甚至还能在噩梦中看到他那邪恶的笑容...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Anyway, thanks for that
drink, it really helped me
settle my nerves. But I must
warn you not to look for that
strange Bard. I'm sure he's really some sort of demon or something...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
总之，谢谢你的饮料，真的让我放松了不少。但我必须警告你，不要去找那个奇怪的诗人。我确信他一定是某种恶魔之类的东西...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
But... If you really
want to attain that sort
of power, I can't really
stop you. Thankfully, nobody
has any idea of where he is~
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
但是...如果你真的想获得那种力量，我也无法阻止你。幸运的是，没人知道他在哪里~

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Even if you could find that
Bard to get him to teach you
how he did that to me, I'm sure
he mentioned something about
being at least ^660000Job Level 40^000000 to
be able to handle that power...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
即使你能找到那个诗人，让他教你他对我做的那些事，我确信他提到过，至少需要^660000职业等级 40^000000才能驾驭那种力量...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 Well, maybe all Bards
and Minstrels aren't terrifying. But any Bard will remind me
of the one that I met during my
travels. Just thinking about
that time gives me goosebumps.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
^333333*叹气*^000000 嗯，也许并非所有诗人和宫廷乐师都很可怕。但任何诗人都让我想起我在旅途中遇到的那个。光是想想那次经历，我就浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh...?! Um, th-that's
nice of y-you to offer,
but I'm p-pretty picky
about what I d-drink.
P-plus, I don't k-know
if I can t-trust you.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
呃...？嗯，谢...谢谢你的好意，但我对喝什么很挑剔。而且，我不确定我是否信任你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
I don't think there's
much that could get m-me
to ch-change my m-mind!
Well... Maybe if you brought
my favorite drink, Tropical
Sograt, I would reconsider...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
我觉得没什么能让我改变主意！嗯...也许如果你带我最喜欢的饮料，热带索格拉特，我会重新考虑...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry,
I won't hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，
我不会伤害你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Th-that's what th-they
all say, right before they
get into your mind and then
twist it as hard as they can!
J-just don't t-touch me!
...Ack! And stay away!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
他...他们总是这么说，就在他们侵入你的思想，然后拼命扭曲它之前！别...别碰我！
...啊！离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Th-that's what th-they
all say, right before they
get into your mind and then
twist it as hard as they can!
E-even if you d-don't have
that p-power, l-leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
他...他们总是这么说，就在他们侵入你的思想，然后拼命扭曲它之前！即...即使你没有那种力量，也请...请离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh... Oh goodness.
Was that a Bard just
over there? Oh, I'm so
afraid of those guys!
And those Minstrels
are even worse!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
哦...天哪。
刚才那边是不是有个诗人？哦，我好怕那些人！
还有那些宫廷乐师，更糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Don't get me wrong, I love
songs and entertainment,
but you've got to understand!
Some of them have powers
that you wouldn't believe!
I... I've seen them myself!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的年轻人]
别误会，我喜欢音乐和娱乐，但你必须理解！
他们中的一些人拥有你无法想象的力量！
我...我亲眼见过！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Been making good use of
what I taught you? Just be
careful and don't use that skill recklessly. Otherwise, people
will hate you as they hate me.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嘿嘿嘿~
你好好利用我教你的东西了吗？只要小心点，别乱用那个技能。否则，人们会像恨我一样恨你。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Your enemies, and the
occasional drunkard, on
the other hand, are different
matters entirely! Bwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
至于你的敌人，还有偶尔遇到的酒鬼，那就完全是另一回事了！哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Impossible! You forgot
everything I've taught you?
How can that be? Oh well, it's
no trouble for me to teach that
to you again if you'd like.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
不可能！你把我教你的都忘了？
怎么会这样？好吧，如果你愿意的话，
我再教你一次也不麻烦。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Thanks, I'd appreciate that.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
What...?
You really don't
want to learn it?
I assure you there's
no strings attached.
If you change your mind...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
什...？
你真的不想学吗？
我向你保证，没有任何附加条件。
如果你改变主意...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
First, you must stare
fiercely into the eyes of
your target, and focus on
thoughts of dominance. This
is the basis for mesmerization. Now listen to this incantation...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
首先，你必须凶猛地凝视目标的眼睛，
并专注于支配的想法。这是催眠的基础。
现在，听好这段咒语...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Uuuummm Baaalaaaa
Uuuummmm Baaalaaa~
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Oooumm guandlejdl
Woooo Ei ei ei ei......
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
Uuuummm Baaalaaaa
Uuuummmm Baaalaaa~
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Oooumm guandlejdl
Woooo Ei ei ei ei......

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Pang's Voice is used to
confuse people and disrupt
control of their bodies. It's not a fatal skill, but it is effective
in mentally upsetting your enemy. Make very wise use of this skill.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
阵痛之声用于迷惑他人，并扰乱其身体的控制。
这不是致命技能，但在精神上扰乱敌人方面非常有效。
请明智地使用这个技能。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Been making good use of
what I taught you? Just be
careful and don't use that skill recklessly. Otherwise, people
will hate you as they hate me.

Your enemies, and the

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, you've brought me
a Munak Doll made by
Yao Jun, just like you said
you would. Ah yes, this is her
craftsmanship, impeccable
as always. You've done well~
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
啊，你带来了妖君制作的僵尸娃娃，
就像你说的那样。啊是的，这是她的工艺，
一如既往地完美。你做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Riott]
To fulfill my part of this
bargain, I shall now teach
you my special skill. Now,
I developed this by listening
to incantations by the Utan
Shaman in Umbala.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
为了履行我在这笔交易中的部分，
我现在将教你我的特殊技能。
我是通过聆听汶巴拉的乌坦萨满的咒语开发出来的。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
First, you must stare
fiercely into the eyes of
your target, and focus on
thoughts of dominance. This
is the basis for mesmerization. Now listen to this incantation...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
首先，你必须凶猛地凝视目标的眼睛，
并专注于支配的想法。这是催眠的基础。
现在，听好这段咒语...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
''Toad's leg, Verit's heart,
spinning stars, spilling zeny,
hands and feet tied. Is this
voices yours, is this voice
mine. Head spinning, head
spinning, head spinning...!''
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
''蛙王的腿，毕莱特的心脏，
旋转的星星，洒落的Zeny，
手脚被绑住。这是你的声音，还是我的声音。
头晕，头晕，头晕...！''

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Remember, it doesn't matter
what you say, but how you say
it. Hypnotically induce your
target with a forbiddenly
seductive rhythm and your
grasp will be inescapable!
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
记住，重要的不是你说什么，而是你怎么说。
用禁忌的诱惑节奏催眠你的目标，
你的掌控将无懈可击！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, and use sleight of
hand to distract your target
from your true motive! I find
that casting Unbarring Octave
with this skill works best. This skill's name is ''Pang Voice!''
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
啊，还要用手艺分散目标的注意力，
使其偏离你的真实动机！我发现
用这个技能施放冷笑话效果最好。
这个技能的名字叫''阵痛之声！''

scripts.text:
[Riott]
''Pang Voice'' will mentally
shock your target and disrupt
control of his own body for
a while. You can't exert control
over victims with this skill, but they usually assume otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
''阵痛之声''会在精神上冲击目标，
并暂时扰乱其对自己身体的控制。
你不能用这个技能控制受害者，
但他们通常会这么认为...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
You need to be judicious in
your use of this skill! Don't
use it recklessly, or people
will come to hate you as they
hate me. But ''Pang Voice'' can be welcome is certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
你需要谨慎地使用这个技能！
不要乱用，否则人们会像恨我一样恨你。
但在某些情况下，''阵痛之声''是受欢迎的。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Subject your enemies to
Pang Voice as much as you
like, and no one will blame
you for it. And you can get away with casting Pang Voice on bullies
and drunkards occasionally...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
你可以随意对敌人使用阵痛之声，
没有人会责怪你。而且你偶尔可以对
欺负人和酒鬼使用阵痛之声...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmpf. Weren't able
to find me a Munak Doll
yet? Well, don't worry, I'm
a patient man. Just try to get
one for me as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
哼。还没找到僵尸娃娃吗？
好吧，别担心，我是个有耐心的人。
尽快给我弄一个吧。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, you've brought me
some fresh eggs laid by
Yhelle, just like I asked.
I'm sure it was dangerous
going to Niflheim, but the flavor of these eggs is worth it.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
啊，你带来了伊蕾尔新下的蛋，
就像我要求的那样。我相信去尼弗海姆很危险，
但这些蛋的味道值得。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
To fulfill my part of this
bargain, I shall now teach
you my special skill. Now,
I developed this by listening
to incantations by the Utan
Shaman in Umbala.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
为了履行我在这笔交易中的部分，
我现在将教你我的特殊技能。
我是通过聆听汶巴拉的乌坦萨满的咒语开发出来的。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
First, you must stare
fiercely into the eyes of
your target, and focus on
thoughts of dominance. This
is the basis for mesmerization. Now listen to this incantation...

[里奥特]

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmm... You didn't
bring enough Eggs...
This will not do. It'll
be a while until Yhelle
will be able to lay more
eggs. Yes, this isn't enough...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯...你带的蛋不够...
这可不行。伊蕾尔
需要一段时间才能下更多的蛋。
是的，这不够...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Well, to make up for the
missing eggs, go and get 
me ^4D4DFF1 Munak Doll^000000. I know that
Yao Jun's Munak Dolls are
masterpieces, and I am an
an avid collector of her work.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
好吧，为了弥补缺少的蛋，
去给我弄^4D4DFF1个僵尸娃娃^000000。
我知道妖君的僵尸娃娃是杰作，
我是她作品的狂热收藏家。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
In the meanwhile,
I'll enjoy the few
eggs that you do have!
Bweh heh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
在此期间，
我会享用你带来的几个蛋！
哇嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: [Riott]
scripts.translation: [里奥特]

scripts.text:
[Riott]
So have you been
having trouble gathering
eggs from Yhelle? I know
she can be one fast running
chicken. But to survive where
she roosts, she has to be.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
所以，你在收集伊蕾尔的蛋时遇到麻烦了吗？
我知道她跑得飞快。
但为了在栖息地生存下来，她不得不如此。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmmrmpf!
Eh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
哼哼！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What's so funny?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
有什么好笑的？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Black Seals that can only
be given by Kino Kitty. You
must be a person of great
emotional depth if he favors
you enough to give you that.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯？啊！那是基诺·基蒂才能给予的黑色海豹宝宝。
如果你能得到它的青睐，
说明你有着丰富的情感深度。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Silver Seals that can only
be given by Errende. You
must be truly kind at heart
if he has offered to be your
friend. How about that?
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯？啊！那是艾伦德才能给予的银色海豹宝宝。
如果你能得到它的青睐，
说明你心地善良。真是不错呢。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Hey, take a look
at those two drunks
all the way over there.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嘿嘿嘿~
嘿，看看那边那两个醉汉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, I can see them.
But what's so special
about those two guys?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我看到了。
但那两个人有什么特别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Just...
Keep watching.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
只要...
继续看着就好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFRiott stared intensely
at one of the drunken men
and began to harshly murmur
some indistinct words in a
low, hoarse voice. One of the
men starts slightly convulsing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF里奥特死死地盯着其中一个醉汉，
开始用低沉沙哑的声音
含糊不清地低声咒骂。
其中一个男人开始轻微抽搐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
H-hey...! ^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
What are you doing?!
K-keep your hands to
yourself! Do I look
like a woman to you?
scripts.translation:
[有点醉的家伙]
嘿...！^333333*打嗝！*^000000
你在干什么？！
把手拿开！
我看起来像女人吗？

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
What are you talking
about? Wh-what?! Why
are my arms all wrapped
around you? S-sorry, I was
trying to just go that w--
I wasn't trying to hug you!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的家伙]
你在说什么？什...什么？！
为什么我的手臂
都缠在你身上了？
对...对不起，我只是想走那边--
我不是想抱你！

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
Bumping into me,
I understand. But a full
blown hug? Come on, now!
That was totally on purpose!
Wh-what? My h-hand! It's...
It's moving my itself?!
scripts.translation:
[有点醉的家伙]
撞到我，我理解。
但完全拥抱？
拜托！
那绝对是故意的！
什...什么？我的手！
它...
它在自己动？！

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
Ack! Wh-what are
you doing! S-stop
touching my butt!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的家伙]
啊！你...你在干什么！
停...停下！
别摸我的屁股！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe two men continued
to gesticulate and move
wildly without direction.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF两个男人继续
毫无方向地
疯狂地挥舞手臂和身体。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those two...
Those two probably
had way too much to drink.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那两个人...
那两个人
肯定喝得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Nah, they just lost
control of their bodies
for a bit. It's the result
of my skill which sort of
scrambles their minds.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
不，他们只是
暂时失去了对身体的控制。
这是我的技能
扰乱了他们心智的结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mind scrambling?
Wait, are you the same
Bard who made someone
jump off Umbala's Bungee
Jump against his will?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
扰乱心智？
等等，你是那个
让某人违背意愿
从汶巴拉的蹦极跳下去的诗人吗？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Huh? How did you
learn about that?
I'm not proud of that,
(even though it was
hilarious at the time)
but yeah, that was me.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
哈？你是怎么
知道那件事的？
我并不为此感到自豪，
（虽然当时确实很搞笑）
但没错，那就是我。

scripts.text: Please teach me that skill!
scripts.translation: 请教我那个技能！

scripts.text: Oh, alright. Just checking.
scripts.translation: 哦，好的。只是随便问问。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? You want to learn
how to scramble minds
like I did just now? Well,
I invented this skill, though
I did have a lot of help from
the Utan Shaman. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯？你想学我刚才那样扰乱心智的技巧吗？好吧，这个技能是我发明的，虽然我也得到了乌坦萨满的很多帮助。让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Alright. If you want me
to teach you, then bring me
5 Eggs from a chicken named
Yhelle. Yhelle lays the highest
quality eggs: they're delicious
and great for a Bard's voice~
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
好吧。如果你想让我教你，那就给我带5个亨·耶勒的鸡蛋。亨·耶勒下的蛋品质最高：既美味，又对诗人的嗓音有益~

scripts.text:
[Riott]
However, this chicken roosts
in a strange, dangerous place.
You'll need to explore this huge, mysterious tree in Umbala in order
to get there. Last time I went,
I pretty much almost died.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
不过，这只鸡栖息在一个奇怪又危险的地方。你需要探索汶巴拉那棵巨大而神秘的树才能到达那里。上次我去的时候，差点就死在那里了。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Alright...
So don't forget
to come back here
and bring me back
^4D4DFF5 Yhelle's Eggs^000000, alright?
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
好了...
别忘了回来这里，
把^4D4DFF5亨·耶勒的鸡蛋^000000带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Boy, you're a curious one.
But if you know about that
and you bumped into me, you
must certainly travel around
a lot. I can respect a good,
seasoned adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
哇，你还挺好奇的。
但既然你知道那些事，
又碰巧遇到我，
那你一定经常四处旅行。
我很尊重像你这样
经验丰富的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wha...?
I can't believe you.
Mind scrambling? That
doesn't make any sense!
They're just really drunk...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...？
我真不敢相信你。
扰乱心智？那
根本说不通！
他们只是喝得太醉了...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
How dare you question my
power? Oh well, I suppose
I really can't be too angry.
Most people who do believe
me usually claim that I'm
an axis of evil about now...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
你竟敢质疑我的力量？
算了，我想我也不能太生气。
大多数相信我的人，
通常都会说我是邪恶的化身...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Eh, nothing much. Say,
you don't have any Bard
Seals? That's a sure sign
that you haven't been really
connecting with the Bard
community. That's a shame...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯，没什么特别的。对了，
你身上没有诗人印章吧？
这说明你并没有真正融入
诗人圈子。真可惜...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
*Sigh* Alright, I know
how you can meet more Bards.
Why don't you try making friends with Errende? Look for a Bard
dressed in green in Geffen and
you should be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
*叹气* 好吧，我知道
怎么让你认识更多诗人。
为什么不试着和艾伦德交朋友呢？
在吉芬找一个穿绿色衣服的诗人，
你应该就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmmrmpf!
Eh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
哼哼！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What's so funny?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
有什么好笑的？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Black Seals that can only
be given by Kino Kitty. You
must be a person of great
emotional depth if he favors
you enough to give you that.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯？啊！那是基诺·基蒂才能给予的黑色海豹宝宝。
如果你能得到它的青睐，
说明你有着丰富的情感深度。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Silver Seals that can only
be given by Errende. You
must be truly kind at heart
if he has offered to be your
friend. How about that?
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯？啊！那是艾伦德才能给予的银色海豹宝宝。
如果你能得到它的青睐，
说明你心地善良。真是不错呢。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Hey, take a look
at those two drunks
all the way over there.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嘿嘿嘿~
嘿，看看那边那两个醉汉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, I can see
together. But what
about them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我能
理解。但那些
人呢？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Just...
Keep watching.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
只要...
继续看着就好。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Eh, nothing much. Say,
I notice you don't have
any Bard seals. That tells
me that you don't really
meet that many Bards. You
should really change that.
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
嗯，没什么特别的。对了，
我注意到你身上没有
诗人印章。这说明
你并没有真正认识
很多诗人。你应该
改变一下这种情况。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Bards and Minstrels can
make some pretty handy
friends if you give them
a chance. Here, why don't
you find Errende in Geffen?
He's a pretty popular guy...
scripts.translation:
[里奥特]
诗人和宫廷乐师
如果给他们机会，
会成为很得力的朋友。
这里，为什么不去
吉芬找艾伦德呢？
他是个很受欢迎的人...

scripts.text:
[Hen Yhelle]
Cluck-Cluuuck?
Cluck cluck cluck!
scripts.translation:
[亨·耶勒]
咯咯-咯...？
咯咯咯咯！

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon sensing your
presense, the hen
quickly ran away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF感觉到你的存在，
母鸡迅速跑开了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
What do you think
is the best drink in
all the world? I think
the Tri-- Tristan? What
was it called again?
scripts.translation:
[有点醉的家伙]
你觉得世界上
